text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a race today. I go to watch, and
see that
there's some commotion on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon and another runner are
talking
about something...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's just you and me! I'm not gonna go
easy on
you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Well, it seems like she's been in a
slump
recently.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I told her she should just think about
beating me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm gonna lose, though!
Throw a few
cheers our way if ya feel
like it. See ya!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Hishiama! I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's the right attitude! All right,
we're
going to
do this for real!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: (Huh... She's running pretty well now.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Now to break out from the back of the
pack and
get on her heels... Let's go!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You've got a long way to go before you
can block
the great Hishiama! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: No way! She passed me!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon! Hishi Amazon has taken
first place! She made a comeback in the
last half of the race
and took the lead!
What a surprising victory!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It was barely a workout!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...You crushed me. But, thanks to your
advice,
I've managed to break free from
my slump!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear it. You were tearing up the
track out
there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
From now on, if you ever hit a wall like
that, just
run right through it without a
second thought!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Your path will become clear!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I will!
